llms.body:
# Checkout.com: High-performance global payments platform for enterprise and scaling businesses

Checkout.com is a financial technology company that provides a cloud-based payments platform enabling businesses to accept payments, send payouts, manage card programs, and optimize payment performance across six continents.

## Products

### Connect — Global Payments Network

- [Accept Online](https://www.checkout.com/products/accept-online): Process payments with flexible integration options tailored to your business.
- [Unified Payments API](https://www.checkout.com/products/unified-payments-api): Connect to all payment methods through a single API integration.
- [Flow](https://www.checkout.com/products/flow): Boost conversions with customizable payment blocks and checkout experiences.
- [Hosted Payment Page](https://www.checkout.com/products/hosted-payment): Deploy a pre-built, low-code payment page integration.
- [Mobile SDK](https://www.checkout.com/products/mobile-sdk): Build native mobile checkout experiences for iOS and Android.
- [Payment Links](https://www.checkout.com/products/payment-links): Accept payments on any channel using shareable payment links.
- [Plugins](https://www.checkout.com/products/plugins): Integrate Checkout.com into existing ecommerce platforms via pre-built plugins.

### Move — Payins and Payouts

- [Acquiring](https://www.checkout.com/products/acquiring): Access local acquiring capabilities across global markets.
- [Payment Methods](https://www.checkout.com/payment-methods): Process cards, bank transfers, and alternative payment methods worldwide.
- [Issuing](https://www.checkout.com/products/issuing): Launch and manage your own card program.
- [Payouts](https://www.checkout.com/technology/payouts): Send payouts to bank accounts and cards globally.

### Protect — Fraud, Risk, and Compliance

- [Fraud Detection](https://www.checkout.com/products/fraud-detection): Build and manage a robust risk and fraud prevention strategy.
- [Authentication (3DS)](https://www.checkout.com/products/authentication-3ds): Simplify 3D Secure authentication and regulatory compliance.
- [Identity Verification](https://www.checkout.com/products/identity-verification): Verify customer identities using AI-powered video technology.
- [Disputes](https://www.checkout.com/products/disputes): Manage and protect against chargebacks and payment disputes.
- [Vault](https://www.checkout.com/products/vault): Securely store, tokenize, and enrich payment data.

### Boost — Payment Performance

- [Intelligent Acceptance](https://www.checkout.com/products/intelligent-acceptance): Increase revenue and approval rates using AI-driven optimization.
- [Network Tokens](https://www.checkout.com/products/network-tokens): Encrypt and secure card payments with network-level tokenization.
- [Real-Time Account Updater](https://www.checkout.com/products/real-time-account-updater): Keep recurring payments flowing by automatically updating expired card details.

### Manage — Money Movement Controls

- [Dashboard](https://www.checkout.com/products/dashboard): Monitor and manage payment performance from a unified dashboard.
- [Treasury & FX](https://www.checkout.com/products/treasury-fx): Manage multi-currency cash flow, balances, and foreign exchange.

## Solutions by Industry

- [Ecommerce](https://www.checkout.com/solutions/ecommerce): Payments for retail, fashion, consumer goods, and digital services businesses.
- [Gaming](https://www.checkout.com/solutions/gaming): Payments for sports betting, e-sports, game streaming, and virtual reality.
- [Marketplaces](https://www.checkout.com/solutions/marketplaces): Payments for multi-sided markets and platform businesses.
- [Travel](https://www.checkout.com/solutions/travel): Payments for online booking platforms, travel agents, and supplier partners.
- [Fintech](https://www.checkout.com/solutions/fintech): Payments for neobanks, money transfer, trading, and insurance companies.
- [Crypto](https://www.checkout.com/solutions/crypto): Payments for cryptocurrency exchanges and wallets.
- [Payment Facilitators](https://www.checkout.com/solutions/payment-facilitators): Payments for fintechs and financial service providers acting as facilitators.

## Ecosystem

- [International Coverage](https://www.checkout.com/solutions/international-coverage): Overview of Checkout.com's global payments network and market coverage.
- [Partners](https://www.checkout.com/partners): Directory of ecommerce platform and technology integration partners.

## Documentation & Developer Resources

- [Developer Docs](https://www.checkout.com/docs): Step-by-step technical guides and integration documentation.
- [API Reference](https://api-reference.checkout.com/): Comprehensive API reference for the Checkout.com payments platform.
- [Test Account](https://www.checkout.com/get-test-account): Create a sandbox account to test, simulate, and explore features.
- [Trust Center](https://trust.checkout.com/): Review Checkout.com's security practices and compliance certifications.
- [Support](https://support.checkout.com/): Help center with answers to common questions and technical issues.

## Resources & Blog

- [Resource Center](https://www.checkout.com/resources): Blog posts, guides, reports, and expert perspectives on payment technology.
- [Case Studies](https://www.checkout.com/case-studies): Real-world merchant success stories from brands like Spotify, eBay, Uber, and more.
- [Newsroom](https://www.checkout.com/newsroom): Press releases, company announcements, and media resources.
- [Forrester Wave Report](https://www.checkout.com/forrester-wave): Checkout.com's recognition as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™ Merchant Payment Providers Q1 2026.

### Blog Topics

- [Digital Economy](https://www.checkout.com/resources/e-commerce): Insights on ecommerce trends and the digital economy.
- [Agentic Commerce](https://www.checkout.com/resources/agentic-commerce): Coverage of AI-powered agentic commerce and its impact on payments.
- [Payment Optimization](https://www.checkout.com/resources/payments-optimization): Guides on improving payment approval rates and reducing costs.
- [Payment Acceptance](https://www.checkout.com/resources/payment-acceptance): Articles on maximizing payment acceptance globally.
- [Fraud & Risk](https://www.checkout.com/resources/fraud-risk): Expert content on fraud prevention and risk management strategies.
- [Alternative Payment Methods](https://www.checkout.com/resources/apms): Insights on local and alternative payment methods worldwide.
- [Authentication](https://www.checkout.com/resources/authentication): Content on 3DS, SCA, and payment authentication best practices.
- [Disputes](https://www.checkout.com/resources/disputes): Guidance on chargeback management and dispute resolution.
- [Regulations](https://www.checkout.com/resources/regulations): Updates on payment regulations and compliance requirements.
- [Payouts](https://www.checkout.com/resources/payouts): Articles on global payout strategies and capabilities.
- [Integrated Platforms](https://www.checkout.com/resources/integrated-platforms): Content for platform businesses and payment facilitators.
- [Issuing](https://www.checkout.com/resources/issuing): Insights on card issuing programs and use cases.
- [Crypto & Web3](https://www.checkout.com/resources/crypto-web3): Coverage of cryptocurrency and Web3 payment trends.

### Blog by Region

- [Asia Pacific](https://www.checkout.com/resources/asia-pacific): Payment insights specific to the APAC market.
- [Europe](https://www.checkout.com/resources/europe): Payment insights specific to the European market.
- [Middle East & North Africa](https://www.checkout.com/resources/middle-east): Payment insights specific to the MENA market.
- [North America](https://www.checkout.com/resources/north-america): Payment insights specific to the North American market.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://www.checkout.com/pricing): Overview of pricing structures including flat-rate and interchange++ options, with free processing for registered charities.

## Company

- [Our Mission](https://www.checkout.com/mission): Checkout.com's mission to help businesses thrive in the digital economy.
- [Our Customers](https://www.checkout.com/customers): Showcase of global brands powered by Checkout.com including Wise, Sony, Alibaba, and more.
- [Contact Us](https://www.checkout.com/contact-us): Get in touch with the Checkout.com team.
- [Contact Sales](https://www.checkout.com/contact-sales): Speak with sales about high-performance payment solutions.
- [Careers](https://www.checkout.com/careers): Information about working at Checkout.com and company culture.
- [Job Openings](https://www.checkout.com/jobs): Browse and apply for open positions at Checkout.com.
- [For Consumers](https://www.checkout.com/for-consumers): Personal dashboard for consumers to manage saved payment details across Checkout.com merchants.

## Social Media

- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/checkout): Checkout.com's official LinkedIn page.
- [X (Twitter)](https://twitter.com/checkout): Checkout.com's official X/Twitter account.

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const counters = document.querySelectorAll(".counter-number");

  const animateCounter = (el) => {
    const start = parseInt(el.getAttribute("data-start"));
    const end = parseInt(el.getAttribute("data-end"));
    const duration = 3000;
    let startTime = null;

    const step = (timestamp) => {
      if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
      const progress = timestamp - startTime;
      const value = Math.min(Math.floor(start + (end - start) * (progress / duration)), end);
      el.textContent = value.toLocaleString();
      if (progress < duration) {
        requestAnimationFrame(step);
      } else {
        el.textContent = end.toLocaleString();
      }
    };

    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, obs) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        setTimeout(() => animateCounter(entry.target), 100);
        obs.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.10 });

  counters.forEach(counter => observer.observe(counter));
});
</script></div></section><section data-track-section="Performance video" class="home-video-section v2"><div class="pv-sticky"><div class="pv-wrapper"><div class="pv-embed w-embed w-iframe w-script"><style>

<script>
  (function () {
    var LOAD_MARGIN = '500px';

    // Animacija
    var START_WIDTH_DESKTOP = 0.4; // 992px+
    var START_WIDTH_TABLET = 0.55; // 768px - 991px
    var START_WIDTH_MOBILE = 0.7; // do 767px
    var VIDEO_RATIO = 9 / 16;
    var SCRUB = 0.25;
    var EASE = 'none';

    var GSAP_SRC = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/gsap.min.js';
    var ST_SRC = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js';

    function ready(fn) {
      if (document.readyState !== 'loading') fn();
      else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
    }

    function loadScript(src) {
      return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        var s = document.createElement('script');
        s.src = src;
        s.async = true;
        s.onload = resolve;
        s.onerror = reject;
        document.head.appendChild(s);
      });
    }

    function loadGsap() {
      var gsapReady = window.gsap ? Promise.resolve() : loadScript(GSAP_SRC);
      return gsapReady.then(function () {
        if (window.ScrollTrigger) return;
        return loadScript(ST_SRC);
      });
    }

    var apiPromise;
    function loadVimeoApi() {
      if (apiPromise) return apiPromise;
      apiPromise = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        if (window.Vimeo && window.Vimeo.Player) return resolve(window.Vimeo);
        var s = document.createElement('script');
        s.src = 'https://player.vimeo.com/api/player.js';
        s.async = true;
        s.onload = function () {
          resolve(window.Vimeo);
        };
        s.onerror = reject;
        document.head.appendChild(s);
      });
      return apiPromise;
    }

    function initAnimation(track, sticky, wrapper) {
      loadGsap()
        .then(function () {
          gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

          var letters = track.querySelectorAll('.letters-wrapper.top, .letters-wrapper.middle');

          function trackTop() {
            return track.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset;
          }

          // Slova: top i middle idu na 0rem
          function animateLetters(scrollConfig) {
            if (!letters.length) return;
            gsap.to(letters, {
              y: '0rem',
              ease: EASE,
              scrollTrigger: scrollConfig,
            });
          }

          // Ispod 992px: video centriran u sekciji, sve vreme 16:9
          // Pocetak: vrh videa udje u ekran odozdo
          // Kraj: centar videa na centru ekrana
          function smallScreen(startWidth) {
            return function () {
              var scrollConfig = {
                trigger: track,
                start: function () {
                  var center = trackTop() + track.offsetHeight / 2;
                  var videoHeight = sticky.offsetWidth * startWidth * VIDEO_RATIO;
                  return center - videoHeight / 2 - window.innerHeight;
                },
                end: function () {
                  return trackTop() + track.offsetHeight / 2 - window.innerHeight / 2;
                },
                scrub: SCRUB,
                invalidateOnRefresh: true,
              };

              animateLetters(scrollConfig);

              gsap.fromTo(
                wrapper,
                { width: startWidth * 100 + '%' },
                {
                  width: '100%',
                  ease: EASE,
                  scrollTrigger: scrollConfig,
                },
              );
            };
          }

          var mm = gsap.matchMedia();

          // Desktop: sticky, do punog ekrana
          mm.add('(min-width: 992px)', function () {
            var scrollConfig = {
              trigger: track,
              start: 'top top',
              end: 'bottom bottom',
              scrub: SCRUB,
              invalidateOnRefresh: true,
            };

            animateLetters(scrollConfig);

            gsap.fromTo(
              wrapper,
              {
                width: START_WIDTH_DESKTOP * 100 + '%',
                height: function () {
                  return sticky.offsetWidth * START_WIDTH_DESKTOP * VIDEO_RATIO;
                },
              },
              {
                width: '100%',
                height: '100%',
                ease: EASE,
                scrollTrigger: scrollConfig,
              },
            );
          });

          mm.add('(min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 991px)', smallScreen(START_WIDTH_TABLET));
          mm.add('(max-width: 767px)', smallScreen(START_WIDTH_MOBILE));
        })
        .catch(function () {});
    }

    function initPlayer(wrapper) {
      var iframe = wrapper.querySelector('.pv-iframe');
      var playBtn = wrapper.querySelector('.pv-play');
      var muteBtn = wrapper.querySelector('.pv-mute');
      var tooltip = wrapper.querySelector('.pv-tooltip');
      var loadedBar = wrapper.querySelector('.pv-progress-loaded');
      var playedBar = wrapper.querySelector('.pv-progress-played');
      if (!iframe || !playBtn || !muteBtn || !iframe.dataset.src) return;

      var loaded = false;
      var userPaused = false;

      function setPlayState(paused) {
        var label = paused ? 'Play' : 'Pause';
        playBtn.classList.toggle('is-paused', paused);
        playBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
        tooltip.textContent = label;
      }

      var loader = new IntersectionObserver(
        function (entries) {
          entries.forEach(function (entry) {
            if (!entry.isIntersecting || loaded) return;
            loaded = true;
            loader.disconnect();

            iframe.src = iframe.dataset.src;
            iframe.removeAttribute('data-src');

            loadVimeoApi()
              .then(function (Vimeo) {
                var player = new Vimeo.Player(iframe);

                player.on('play', function () {
                  setPlayState(false);
                });

                player.on('pause', function () {
                  setPlayState(true);
                });

                player.on('timeupdate', function (data) {
                  playedBar.style.width = data.percent * 100 + '%';
                });

                player.on('progress', function (data) {
                  loadedBar.style.width = data.percent * 100 + '%';
                });

                playBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                  player.getPaused().then(function (paused) {
                    userPaused = !paused;
                    if (paused) player.play().catch(function () {});
                    else player.pause().catch(function () {});
                  });
                });

                // Unmute: jednom, pa nestaje
                muteBtn.addEventListener(
                  'click',
                  function () {
                    player.setVolume(1).catch(function () {});
                    player.setMuted(false).catch(function () {});
                    muteBtn.classList.add('is-hidden');
                    muteBtn.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
                    muteBtn.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
                  },
                  { once: true },
                );

                var playback = new IntersectionObserver(
                  function (items) {
                    items.forEach(function (item) {
                      if (item.isIntersecting && item.intersectionRatio >= 0.5) {
                        if (!userPaused) player.play().catch(function () {});
                      } else {
                        player.pause().catch(function () {});
                      }
                    });
                  },
                  { threshold: [0, 0.5] },
                );

                playback.observe(wrapper);
              })
              .catch(function () {});
          });
        },
        { rootMargin: LOAD_MARGIN + ' 0px' },
      );

      loader.observe(wrapper);
    }

    ready(function () {
      var sticky = document.querySelector('.pv-sticky');
      if (!sticky) return;

      var wrapper = sticky.querySelector('.pv-wrapper');
      var track = sticky.parentElement;
      if (!wrapper || !track) return;

      initPlayer(wrapper);
      initAnimation(track, sticky, wrapper);
    });
  })();

We empower businesses to accept payments online and disburse funds to their entities and customers through a range of payment methods and integration options.</p><p>To help merchants accept the highest possible number of legitimate payments while preventing fraud, we offer Intelligent Acceptance, Authentication, Identity Verification, and Fraud Detection tools. With these tools, businesses can find the point between risk and acceptance that’s right for them.</p><p>We also help our merchants direct funds flexibly, giving them a view of their balances across payins and payouts across all geographies and currencies, allowing them to manage these payments through a single dashboard.</p></div></div></div><div class="faq-item"><div class="faq-close-overlay"></div><div class="faq-toggle"><div>Is Checkout.com easy to integrate with?</div><div class="faq-toggle-cross-wrapper"><div class="faq-cross-horizontal-line"></div><div class="faq-cross-vertical-line"></div></div></div><div class="faq-answer"><div class="faq-answer-text w-richtext"><p>We offer a range of integration options, including hosted payment pages – a simple integration method that allows businesses to provide us with payment information, which we use to generate a link that redirects customers to a hosted payments page.</p><p>All of our integration methods are supported by detailed technical documentation, an API reference, and FAQs, with a dedicated support team to help with merchants' questions.</p></div></div></div><div class="faq-item"><div class="faq-close-overlay"></div><div class="faq-toggle"><div>How reliable is Checkout.com’s platform?</div><div class="faq-toggle-cross-wrapper"><div class="faq-cross-horizontal-line"></div><div class="faq-cross-vertical-line"></div></div></div><div class="faq-answer"><div class="faq-answer-text w-richtext"><p>Checkout.com’s platform is built using proprietary technology and is highly resilient. Our platform has self-healing capabilities which improve scalability and optimization, allowing our platform to deliver uptime.<br/>‍<br/>As a cloud-native platform, we take full advantage of utilizing availability zones. This significantly reduces redundancy and improves fault tolerance. In other words, if a failure occurs - be it due to hardware issues, software glitches, network outages, cyberattacks, or even natural disasters - our platform is designed to automatically reroute to a different, functional availability zone. <br/>‍<br/>Our innovative use of technology makes our platform a dependable partner in your business journey.</p></div></div></div><div class="faq-item"><div class="faq-close-overlay"></div><div class="faq-toggle"><div>What markets does Checkout.com operate in?</div><div class="faq-toggle-cross-wrapper"><div class="faq-cross-horizontal-line"></div><div class="faq-cross-vertical-line"></div></div></div><div class="faq-answer"><div class="faq-answer-text w-richtext"><p>Checkout.com is a global payment service provider with local acquiring capabilities in over 50 countries across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.<br/><br/>Our platform supports more than 150 processing currencies, enabling businesses to avoid cross-border charges and reduce foreign exchange costs.<br/><br/>We also provide extensive local support through our 19 offices worldwide. Our experts can help you to grow or streamline your payments globally – wherever you are, whenever you need us.</p></div></div></div><div class="faq-item"><div class="faq-close-overlay"></div><div class="faq-toggle"><div>What payment methods can I accept?</div><div class="faq-toggle-cross-wrapper"><div class="faq-cross-horizontal-line"></div><div class="faq-cross-vertical-line"></div></div></div><div class="faq-answer"><div class="faq-answer-text with-link w-richtext"><p>We support all the major card schemes and a range of popular ways for consumers to pay in local markets - including direct debit payment methods, voucher payment schemes, digital wallets, and bank transfers. <script>
  (function () {
    'use strict';

    var HERO_SELECTOR = '.home-hero-section .hero-marquee';
    var DESKTOP_QUERY = '(min-width: 992px)';
    var SECONDS_PER_SLIDE = 8;
    var RESPECT_REDUCED_MOTION = true;
    var MAX_SETS = 6;

    if (!window.matchMedia) return;

    var mqDesktop = window.matchMedia(DESKTOP_QUERY);
    var mqReduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    var canAnimate = typeof Element !== 'undefined' && typeof Element.prototype.animate === 'function';
    var instances = [];

    function listen(mq, fn) {
      if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener('change', fn);
      else if (mq.addListener) mq.addListener(fn);
    }

    function cleanNode(node) {
      node.removeAttribute('data-w-id');
      node.removeAttribute('data-ix');
      node.removeAttribute('id');
    }

    function prepareClone(clone) {
      var nodes = clone.querySelectorAll('[data-w-id],[data-ix],[id]');
      var i;
      cleanNode(clone);
      for (i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) cleanNode(nodes[i]);

      var imgs = clone.getElementsByTagName('img');
      for (i = 0; i < imgs.length; i++) {
        imgs[i].style.opacity = '1';
        imgs[i].style.transform = '';
        imgs[i].style.willChange = '';
        imgs[i].decoding = 'async';
      }
      clone.style.opacity = '';
      clone.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      clone.inert = true;
      return clone;
    }

    function createMarquee(el) {
      var wrapper = el.querySelector('.swiper-wrapper');
      if (!wrapper) return null;

      var originals = Array.prototype.filter.call(wrapper.children, function (c) {
        return c.classList.contains('swiper-slide');
      });
      var n = originals.length;
      if (!n) return null;

      var perSlide = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-marquee-speed')) || SECONDS_PER_SLIDE;
      var duration = n * perSlide * 1000;

      var clones = [];
      var anim = null;
      var key = '';
      var visible = true;
      var timer = 0;
      var ro = null;
      var io = null;

      el.classList.add('is-preparing');

      wrapper.style.display = 'flex';
      wrapper.style.flexDirection = 'column';
      wrapper.style.willChange = 'transform';
      originals.forEach(function (s) { s.style.flexShrink = '0'; });

      function addSet() {
        var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
        originals.forEach(function (s) {
          var c = prepareClone(s.cloneNode(true));
          clones.push(c);
          frag.appendChild(c);
        });
        wrapper.appendChild(frag);
      }

      function sync() {
        if (!anim) return;
        if (visible && !document.hidden) anim.play();
        else anim.pause();
      }

      function clearClones() {
        if (anim) { anim.cancel(); anim = null; }
        clones.forEach(function (c) { if (c.parentNode) c.parentNode.removeChild(c); });
        clones = [];
        key = '';
      }

      function build() {
        if (!clones.length) addSet();

        var setHeight = clones[0].offsetTop - originals[0].offsetTop;
        if (!(setHeight > 0)) { clearClones(); return; }

        // Enough copies to cover the container while one set scrolls out.
        var sets = Math.min(MAX_SETS, Math.max(2, Math.ceil(el.clientHeight / setHeight) + 1));
        while (clones.length < (sets - 1) * n) addSet();
        while (clones.length > (sets - 1) * n) {
          var last = clones.pop();
          if (last.parentNode) last.parentNode.removeChild(last);
        }

        var nextKey = setHeight.toFixed(1) + ':' + sets;
        if (anim && nextKey === key) return;
        key = nextKey;

        var progress = anim && anim.currentTime ? (anim.currentTime % duration) / duration : 0;
        if (anim) anim.cancel();

        anim = wrapper.animate(
          [
            { transform: 'translate3d(0,0,0)' },
            { transform: 'translate3d(0,' + (-setHeight) + 'px,0)' }
          ],
          { duration: duration, iterations: Infinity, easing: 'linear' }
        );
        anim.currentTime = progress * duration;
        sync();
      }

      function schedule() {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = setTimeout(build, 120);
      }

      function onVisibility() { sync(); }

      build();

      if (window.ResizeObserver) {
        ro = new ResizeObserver(schedule);
        ro.observe(el);
        originals.forEach(function (s) { ro.observe(s); });
      } else {
        window.addEventListener('resize', schedule);
        window.addEventListener('load', schedule);
      }

      if (window.IntersectionObserver) {
        io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
          visible = entries[entries.length - 1].isIntersecting;
          sync();
        }, { rootMargin: '100px 0px' });
        io.observe(el);
      }

      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);

      el.classList.remove('is-preparing');
      el.classList.add('is-ready');

      return {
        destroy: function () {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          if (ro) ro.disconnect();
          else {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', schedule);
            window.removeEventListener('load', schedule);
          }
          if (io) io.disconnect();
          document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
          clearClones();
          wrapper.style.removeProperty('display');
          wrapper.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          wrapper.style.removeProperty('will-change');
          originals.forEach(function (s) { s.style.removeProperty('flex-shrink'); });
          el.classList.remove('is-preparing', 'is-ready');
        }
      };
    }

    function setup() {
      var i;
      for (i = 0; i < instances.length; i++) instances[i].destroy();
      instances = [];

      if (!mqDesktop.matches) return;

      var animate = canAnimate && !(RESPECT_REDUCED_MOTION && mqReduce.matches);
      var els = document.querySelectorAll(HERO_SELECTOR);

      for (i = 0; i < els.length; i++) {
        var m = animate ? createMarquee(els[i]) : null;
        if (m) instances.push(m);
        else els[i].classList.add('is-ready');
      }
    }

    listen(mqDesktop, setup);
    listen(mqReduce, setup);

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setup);
    else setup();
  })();
</script>

<!-- TAB SECTION SLIDES -->
<script>
  window.Webflow = window.Webflow || [];
  window.Webflow.push(function () {
    const menuEl = document.querySelector('.product-tab-menu-overflow-mobile');
    const imagesEl = document.querySelector('.product-tab-content-image');
    if (!menuEl || !imagesEl || imagesEl.swiper || typeof Swiper === 'undefined') return;

    const tabList = menuEl.querySelector('.product-tab-menu');
    const tabs = Array.from(menuEl.querySelectorAll('.product-tab-menu-button'));
    if (!tabs.length) return;

    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    const imagesSwiper = new Swiper(imagesEl, {
      speed: 400,
      loop: true,
      allowTouchMove: true,
      autoplay: reduceMotion
        ? false
        : { delay: 7000, disableOnInteraction: false, pauseOnMouseEnter: true },
      breakpoints: {
        992: { allowTouchMove: false },
      },
    });

    // Keep the active tab visible when the menu scrolls horizontally (mobile)
    const scrollTabIntoView = (tab) => {
      const scroller = [menuEl, tabList].find((el) => el && el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth);
      if (!scroller) return;
      const scrollerRect = scroller.getBoundingClientRect();
      const tabRect = tab.getBoundingClientRect();
      const delta = tabRect.left - scrollerRect.left - (scrollerRect.width - tabRect.width) / 2;
      if (Math.abs(delta) < 1) return;
      scroller.scrollBy({ left: delta, behavior: reduceMotion ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
    };

    const setActive = (index, scroll) => {
      tabs.forEach((tab, i) => {
        const isActive = i === index;
        tab.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
        tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(isActive));
        tab.tabIndex = isActive ? 0 : -1;
      });
      if (scroll && tabs[index]) scrollTabIntoView(tabs[index]);
    };

    // ARIA tabs pattern
    if (tabList) tabList.setAttribute('role', 'tablist');

    tabs.forEach((tab, i) => {
      tab.setAttribute('role', 'tab');

      tab.addEventListener('click', () => imagesSwiper.slideToLoop(i));

      tab.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        let next = null;
        if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') next = (i + 1) % tabs.length;
        else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') next = (i - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
        else if (e.key === 'Home') next = 0;
        else if (e.key === 'End') next = tabs.length - 1;
        else if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') next = i;
        if (next === null) return;

        e.preventDefault();
        imagesSwiper.slideToLoop(next);
        tabs[next].focus({ preventScroll: true });
      });
    });

    imagesSwiper.on('realIndexChange', () => setActive(imagesSwiper.realIndex, true));
    setActive(imagesSwiper.realIndex, false);

    // Autoplay runs only while the section is in view and the menu has no keyboard focus
    if (imagesSwiper.params.autoplay && imagesSwiper.params.autoplay.enabled) {
      let inView = true;
      let menuFocused = false;

      const syncAutoplay = () => {
        const shouldRun = inView && !menuFocused;
        if (shouldRun && !imagesSwiper.autoplay.running) imagesSwiper.autoplay.start();
        if (!shouldRun && imagesSwiper.autoplay.running) imagesSwiper.autoplay.stop();
      };

      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        new IntersectionObserver(
          ([entry]) => {
            inView = entry.isIntersecting;
            syncAutoplay();
          },
          { threshold: 0.25 },
        ).observe(imagesEl);
      }

      menuEl.addEventListener('focusin', () => {
        menuFocused = true;
        syncAutoplay();
      });

      menuEl.addEventListener('focusout', (e) => {
        if (menuEl.contains(e.relatedTarget)) return;
        menuFocused = false;
        syncAutoplay();
      });
    }
  });
</script>

<script>
  (function () {

      const description = slide.querySelector('.wheel-slide-description');
      const logo = slide.querySelector('.wheel-slide-logo');
      const logoImg = logo && (logo.tagName === 'IMG' ? logo : logo.querySelector('img'));
      const ctaText = slide.querySelector('.wheel-slide-cta-text');
      const ctaLink = slide.querySelector('.wheel-slide-cta-link');

      return {
        html,
        description: description ? (html ? description.innerHTML : description.textContent) : '',
        logo: (logoImg && logoImg.getAttribute('src')) || '',
        ctaText: ctaText ? ctaText.textContent.trim() : '',

          if (descriptionEl.innerHTML !== data.description) descriptionEl.innerHTML = data.description;
        } else if (descriptionEl.textContent !== data.description) {
          descriptionEl.textContent = data.description;
        }
      }

      if (logoEl && data.logo && logoEl.getAttribute('src') !== data.logo) {
        logoEl.setAttribute('src', data.logo);
      }

      if (ctaEl) {
        if (ctaEl.textContent !== data.ctaText) ctaEl.textContent = data.ctaText;
        if (ctaEl.getAttribute('href') !== data.ctaLink) ctaEl.setAttribute('href', data.ctaLink);
      }
    }

    // ===== Desktop: GSAP wheel =====
    function initDesktop() {
      if (typeof gsap === 'undefined') return null;

      const slides = gsap.utils.toArray('.wheel-slide');
      const total = slides.length;
      if (!total) return null;

      const wrapper = document.querySelector('.wheel-carousel-wrapper');
      const fadeTargets = [descriptionEl, logoEl, ctaEl].filter(Boolean);
      const listeners = [];
      let activeIndex = 0;
      let radius = 0;
      let autoSlide = null;
      let resizeFrame = 0;
      let io = null;

      function on(el, type, fn) {
        if (!el) return;
        el.addEventListener(type, fn);
        listeners.push([el, type, fn]);
      }

      function calculateRadius() {
        radius = ((wrapper && wrapper.offsetWidth) || window.innerWidth) / 2 + 400;
      }

      function showContent(index, animated) {
        const data = readSlide(slides[index], false);
        if (!animated || !fadeTargets.length) {
          renderContent(data);
          return;
        }
        // overwrite drops a pending fade, so rapid clicks never show stale content
        gsap.to(fadeTargets, {
          opacity: 0,
          duration: 0.6,
          overwrite: true,
          onComplete: () => {
            renderContent(data);
            gsap.to(fadeTargets, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.8, overwrite: true });
          },
        });
      }

      function updateSlides(animated) {
        const containerHeight = container.offsetHeight;
        const heights = slides.map((slide) => slide.offsetHeight);

        slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
          let offset = i - activeIndex;
          if (Math.abs(offset) > total / 2) offset += offset > 0 ? -total : total;

          const angle = (offset / total) * 360 - 90;
          const rad = (angle * Math.PI) / 180;
          const props = {
            x: radius * Math.cos(rad),
            y: radius * Math.sin(rad) + containerHeight / 2 - heights[i] / 2,
            rotation: angle + 90,
            scale: offset === 0 ? 1 : 0.7,
          };

          if (animated) gsap.to(slide, { ...props, duration: 1.2, ease: 'power2.inOut', overwrite: 'auto' });
          else gsap.set(slide, props);
        });

        if (animated) showContent(activeIndex, true);
      }

      function startAutoSlide() {
        if (autoSlide) autoSlide.kill();
        autoSlide = gsap.delayedCall(4, () => goTo(activeIndex + 1));
      }

      function goTo(index) {
        activeIndex = (index + total) % total;
        updateSlides(true);
        startAutoSlide();
      }

      // Initial setup
      gsap.set(slides, { position: 'absolute', cursor: 'pointer' });
      calculateRadius();
      updateSlides(false);
      showContent(activeIndex, false);

      // Navigation
      on(document.getElementById('wheel-next'), 'click', () => goTo(activeIndex + 1));
      on(document.getElementById('wheel-prev'), 'click', () => goTo(activeIndex - 1));

      // Clickable slides + hover effect for non-active slides
      slides.forEach((slide, index) => {
        on(slide, 'click', () => {
          if (index !== activeIndex) goTo(index);
        });
        on(slide, 'mouseenter', () => {
          if (index !== activeIndex) gsap.to(slide, { scale: 0.75, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out' });
        });
        on(slide, 'mouseleave', () => {
          if (index !== activeIndex) gsap.to(slide, { scale: 0.7, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out' });
        });
      });

      on(window, 'resize', () => {
        cancelAnimationFrame(resizeFrame);
        resizeFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          calculateRadius();
          updateSlides(false);
        });
      });

      // Start auto slide when trigger enters viewport
      const trigger = document.querySelector('.case-study-trigger');
      if (trigger && 'IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
          if (!entries.some((entry) => entry.isIntersecting)) return;
          startAutoSlide();
          io.disconnect();
        });
        io.observe(trigger);
      }

      return () => {
        listeners.forEach(([el, type, fn]) => el.removeEventListener(type, fn));
        if (io) io.disconnect();
        if (autoSlide) autoSlide.kill();
        cancelAnimationFrame(resizeFrame);
        gsap.killTweensOf(slides);
        gsap.killTweensOf(fadeTargets);
        gsap.set(slides, { clearProps: 'transform,position,cursor' });
        gsap.set(fadeTargets, { clearProps: 'opacity' });
      };
    }

    // ===== Tablet and mobile: Swiper =====
    function initMobile() {
      if (typeof Swiper === 'undefined') return null;

      let lastIndex = -1;

      function sync(swiper) {
        if (swiper.destroyed || swiper.realIndex === lastIndex) return;
        const slide = swiper.slides[swiper.activeIndex];
        if (!slide) return;
        lastIndex = swiper.realIndex;
        renderContent(readSlide(slide, true));
      }

      const swiper = new Swiper(container, {
        slidesPerView: 'auto',
        spaceBetween: 16,
        centeredSlides: true,
        loop: true,
        grabCursor: true,
        navigation: { nextEl: '#wheel-next', prevEl: '#wheel-prev' },
        on: {
          afterInit: sync,
          slideChange: sync,
        },
      });

      return () => swiper.destroy(true, true);
    }

    function apply() {
      if (teardown) teardown();
      teardown = (mq.matches ? initDesktop : initMobile)();
    }

    mq.addEventListener('change', apply);
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', apply);
    else apply();
  })();
</script>
</body></html>
